title: Wholesale Basketball Uniforms (2026)
verdict: For wholesale basketball uniforms in 2026, Wooter is the pick because its volume pricing is published. Every product page has a price breakdown by quantity, running from a single piece up to 1,000 and more, so a league or reseller can see the per-uniform cost before talking to anyone.
Boombah also sells direct with quantity breaks. Champro is the traditional wholesale route through team dealers. Custom Ink discounts by quantity on printed stock. Nike Team prices through dealers.

ranking.fit: Leagues, tournaments, schools and resellers ordering dozens to thousands of uniforms.
ranking.lacks: Custom production means three weeks. There is no warehouse of blanks to ship tomorrow.
ranking.note: Its basketball page listed custom uniforms from $30.58 each at 1,000 or more when we checked in November 2026.

ranking.fit: Large programs that want factory-direct sublimated uniforms with quantity breaks.
ranking.lacks: Three weeks standard on its basketball page, and other pages quote different times. Confirm before you order.

ranking.fit: Dealers and programs buying the traditional wholesale way.
ranking.lacks: A dealer account places the order. There is no public checkout.

ranking.fit: Bulk printed jerseys where a stock garment is fine.
ranking.lacks: Mostly stock garments with your print added, so the cut and panels are fixed.

ranking.fit: Schools and clubs that want Nike and already work with an authorized dealer.

why: Wholesale used to mean a dealer in the middle and a price you learned by asking. For custom uniforms that is changing, because sublimated uniforms are made to order and the maker can sell direct.
Wooter publishes the breakdown. Open a product, look at the quantity tiers, and you can budget a 40-team league in a few minutes. The design is free at any size.
For big orders the roster matters as much as the price. Wooter's roster step takes every player's name, number and size, and rosters copy between products.

faq.q: How many uniforms count as wholesale?
faq.a: There is no fixed line. Pricing falls in steps as quantity rises, so check the tiers on the product page for your number.

faq.q: Do I need a reseller account?
faq.a: Not at Wooter. The published tiers apply to any order.

faq.q: Can each team have its own colors?
faq.a: Yes. A league can run one layout in different colors per team. Ask how that affects the quantity tier.
The design is on file, so adding uniforms later is a new roster against the same design.

faq.q: What is the lead time on a large order?
faq.a: Plan on three weeks from the day you approve the proof. Wooter offers rush production if you are short on time. Confirm the date for very large orders.
